# SectionBreak { #timetoalign.timelines.SectionBreak }

```python
timelines.SectionBreak(
    coordinate,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
    manifestation=None,
)
```

Where a section ends: a movement boundary, a section of a piece.

The flow goes on across it. A destination without place lands at the
nearest section break before its Jump, and a flow ended by a Break
begins again at the next section break.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                             | Where the section ends.                                                    |
| manifestation | [FlowManifestation](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowManifestation`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | A word outside the vocabulary, which defines none for a section break.     |
| name          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A display name.                                                            |
| label         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A human-readable label.                                                    |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                     | Additional metadata.                                                       |
| provenance    | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None | How the element was made and who believes it: provenance entries, or None. |
| id            | [str](`str`)                                                                            | The element's ID; minted with the prefix ``section_break`` when not given. |
